ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_FACTTREASURYOUTSTANDINGINVESTMENT_CM216] AS
BEGIN

WITH CustomerAccountBalance
AS(

SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance WHERE BalanceTypeId IN ('Fixed Income Product Outstanding', 
'Money Market Product Outstanding', 'Structured Product PYA Outstanding', 'Structured Product Asset Swap')
AND SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' AND IsoCurrencyCode = 'PHP' 

)
, CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation
AS(
    select AccountID,
    count(ShareIndicator) as CNT
    from DW.DimCustomerAccount where ShareIndicator = 'Y'
    group by AccountID
)
,CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates
AS(
    select * from Bnkm.CurrencyConversion 
    Where ConvertToCurrencyId  = 'PHP' AND RATEID = 'REV'
)
--INSERT INTO DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment_CM216
--( 
-- BusinessDateSK 
--,BranchSK 
--,BankSK 
--,AccountSK 
--,AccountID 
--,OutstandingInvestmentFull_Original
--,OutstandingInvestmentProrated_Original
--,Currency_Original
--,Currency_Target
--,PesoConversionRate
--,OutstandingInvestmentFull 
--,OutstandingInvestmentProrated 
--,Currency 
--,SourceSystemCode 
--,WorkFlowId 
--,TaskRunId 
--,InsertDttm                                           
--)


SELECT
convert(varchar,BCAB.[Timestamp],112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBANK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountID
,SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount) AS OutstandingInvestmentFull_Original
,ISNULL(SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount) / CNT,SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount)) AS OutstandingInvestmentProrated_Original
,ISNULL(BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode,'PHP') AS Currency_Original
,'PHP' AS Currency_Target
,ISNULL(CC.ConversionRate,1) AS PesoConversionRate
,--SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount) AS OutstandingInvestmentFull
CASE WHEN BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount) * CC.ConversionRate
    ELSE SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount) END OutstandingInvestmentFull
,--SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount / BCAP.CNT) AS OutstandingInvestmentProrated
CASE WHEN BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount) * CC.ConversionRate )/ ISNULL(NULLIF(CNT,''),1)
    ELSE SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount) / ISNULL(NULLIF(CNT,''),1)  
    END OutstandingInvestmentProrated
--,BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode AS Currency
,BCAB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId 
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
INTO DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment_CM216 
FROM CustomerAccountBalance BCAB
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNT BCA ON BCAB.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCAB.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDB.BRANCHID aND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBANK DDBANK ON BCAB.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDBANK.BANKID
LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP ON BCAB.CustomerAccountId = BCAP.AccountId --join for count
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAB.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = DDA.ACCOUNTID AND BCAB.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates CC ON BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertfromCurrencyId AND BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAB.Timestamp = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp 
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment A 
    WHERE DDA.AccountId  = A.AccountId
    AND convert(varchar,BCAB.[Timestamp],112) = A.BusinessDateSK
    AND DDBANK.BankSK = A.BankSK
)
GROUP BY 
BCAB.[Timestamp]
,DDB.BranchSK
,DDBANK.BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId
,BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode
,BCAB.SourceSystemCode
--,BCAB.BalanceAmount
,BCAP.CNT
,CC.Conversionrate



END
GO
